description: Creates a free online invite card (thiệp mời online) on Tickmi for a wedding, birthday, graduation, company event, workshop and more, and returns a link to share, a private manage link (guest list, RSVP answers, wishes) and a link that turns the card into a Tickmi Studio event with RSVP form and QR check-in. Guests open the card on their phone and confirm attendance. No sign-up needed. It does not send the card to anyone and takes no guest list: the user shares the link. Example: "Make an invite for my graduation at Hall A on 2026-12-20 18:00".

host.description: Who invites, e.g. "Ngọc Hân" or "Ban tổ chức".

invite_line.description: Invite line, e.g. "Thân mời bạn đến dự" or "Trân trọng kính mời".

language.description: Language of the page shown to participants: vi (Vietnamese) or en (English).

occasion.description: Occasion: cuoi = wedding, sinh-nhat = birthday, thoi-noi = baby first birthday, tan-gia = housewarming, mung-tho = longevity celebration, tot-nghiep = graduation, hop-lop = class reunion, trung-thu = mid-autumn, noel = Christmas, su-kien = customer conference, hoi-thao = workshop/seminar, ra-mat = product launch, ky-ket = signing ceremony, tri-an = customer appreciation, gala = gala/awards, year-end = year-end party, ky-niem = anniversary, khai-truong = grand opening, khoi-cong = groundbreaking/inauguration, hop-bao = press conference.

organization.description: Organizing company or unit (company events), or class name for a reunion.

start_time.description: Start in Vietnam time, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm, e.g. 2026-12-20T18:00.

theme.description: Design key, e.g. totnghiep, cuoi, hoang, gala, navy, hoa, toigian. Unknown or empty = the default design of the occasion.

title.description: Main title, e.g. "Lễ tốt nghiệp của Ngọc Hân" or, for a wedding, "Minh Anh & Quốc Bảo".

name: create_invite

expires_at.description: ISO time when the tool is deleted if not edited again.

manage_url.description: Private link for the creator to see results and edit. Keep it secret.

studio_import_url.description: invite only: opens Tickmi Studio to turn the card into an event with RSVP and QR check-in.

view_url.description: Link to share with participants (or to open the tool).

title: Create an online invite card
